hyper-defense-native-replacement.scope: The stock client cast 1101, 1100, 1099 and 10 in sequence. Status Bonuses started at +47 for each defense. Thrown Defense rose to +94 (+47), Viral Defense to +124 (+77), Melee Defense to +99 (+52), and Ballistic Defense to +98 (+51). Every new cast removed the previous defense bonus.
